title: GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini retire from Codex on August 31
author: OpenAI / ChatGPT & Codex changelog
why_it_matters: The retirement affects Codex users signed in with ChatGPT and requires updates to workspace defaults, saved model settings, managed configurations, custom agents and scheduled tasks before the cutoff.
actionable_takeaway: Create a Model Migration Freeze List that separates ChatGPT sign-in Codex from API-key Codex and verifies every automation after replacement.

title: Work with more websites in ChatGPT Work and Codex
author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
why_it_matters: The August 24-28 digest separates local browser use, Site tools(WebMCP), and cloud browser sign-in into distinct lanes with different permission and evidence boundaries.
actionable_takeaway: Before any website task, declare the browser lane, allowed actions, readback method, account boundary and stop conditions.

title: Scheduled tasks can respond to app updates and be shared
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Work scheduled tasks can now respond to Gmail, Slack and GitHub activity and be shared as independent workspace copies, changing automation from fixed cron into event-driven operations.
actionable_takeaway: Write a Trigger Envelope for every event task: source app, payload schema, idempotency key, owner, permissions and duplicate handling.

title: Import and sync plugin marketplaces from GitHub
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Workspace admins can import plugin marketplaces from GitHub repositories and keep plugins up to date with automatic daily sync, while app access still requires separate review.
actionable_takeaway: Add a Marketplace Auto-Update Gate with source repository, allowlist, version pin, permission diff, owner and rollback path.

title: Use Apple Messages from Codex and ChatGPT Work
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: Apple Messages connects Work/Codex to a real sending surface on Apple silicon Macs, so preparing a message and sending it must remain separate approval states.
actionable_takeaway: For message workflows, record read/search, draft, recipient confirmation, send approval and post-send evidence as separate gates.

title: ChatGPT release notes add active sessions, apps directory language, and Codex Windows Computer Use
author: OpenAI Help Center
why_it_matters: The August 28 notes combine session visibility, app-directory terminology, Windows Computer Use for Codex, and remote steering from mobile or Mac, reinforcing that device roles and host evidence must be explicit.
actionable_takeaway: Maintain an Agent Session Policy Matrix that says which device hosts files, which device steers, and what counts as completion evidence.

title: GitHub Copilot cloud agent, github.com Chat and GitHub Mobile converge into one policy
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: GitHub plans to unify cloud agent, github.com Chat and Mobile under a single experience and policy no earlier than September 28, with retention and default enablement implications.
actionable_takeaway: Review agent session defaults, mobile access, data retention, sandbox use and opt-out consequences before the policy switch.

title: GitHub Copilot code review default changes toward Balanced effort
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Copilot code review's Default effort setting is moving from Lite to Balanced, which can change cost, latency and review depth for automatic PR reviews.
actionable_takeaway: Pin review effort explicitly at org or repository level if default behavior must not drift on September 28.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases - August 24
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: The weekly release adds shared Slack/Teams agent sessions, a Customize tab for MCP/plugins/skills, Copilot CLI default modes, restore-after-crash, and VS Code cross-agent continuity.
actionable_takeaway: For each agent workbench, record defaultMode, defaultPermissionMode, session restore behavior, plugin/MCP surface and model usage reporting.

title: Copilot code review expands to bot-authored and very large pull requests
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Copilot code review can review bot-authored PRs, Copilot cloud agent PRs with a full agentic review, and PRs that were previously over large-size limits.
actionable_takeaway: Add an Author/Reviewer Independence Gate for AI-authored PRs, including reviewer type, test evidence, risk scope and resolution reason.

title: Enterprise-managed settings now support autoUpdate for plugin marketplaces
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: GitHub Copilot managed settings can opt plugin marketplaces into automatic updates while still requiring the marketplace to be permitted by strictKnownMarketplaces.
actionable_takeaway: Treat autoUpdate as a controlled deployment channel: allowlist marketplace sources, inspect changes and keep a disable or rollback path.

title: Global model policy generally available for GitHub Copilot
author: GitHub Changelog
why_it_matters: Models can inherit a global policy unless explicitly enabled or disabled, and open-weight or data-retention-exception models are treated differently by default.
actionable_takeaway: Maintain a Model Policy Matrix with enabled, disabled, inherited and default-delegated states plus owner and rollout date.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 hardens guardrails and usage accounting
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: The release redacts blocked tool outputs, raises errors for terminal failed/incomplete responses, rejects conflicting provider configuration and isolates RunState usage accounting.
actionable_takeaway: Before upgrading agent runtimes, add tests for guardrail redaction, terminal failure, explicit-client config conflicts and checkpoint usage isolation.

title: Claude Code hooks reference documents lifecycle audit points
author: Anthropic Docs
why_it_matters: The hook model shows concrete lifecycle events for prompt submission, tool calls, permission requests, compaction, config changes and stop failures across agent environments.
actionable_takeaway: Map your own agent stack to pre-tool, post-tool, permission, config-change, compaction and stop-failure audit events.

title: Fake Codex ClickFix campaign targets macOS developers
author: Cato CTRL
why_it_matters: Attackers used sponsored search results and Google Sites to impersonate Codex and push macOS users into pasting terminal commands associated with suspected AMOS delivery.
actionable_takeaway: Create a ClickFix Install Guardrail: trust official domains and package registries, read commands before execution, and reject hidden URLs or curl-pipe-shell patterns.

title: AI-to-AI Code Reviews of GitHub Pull Requests
author: Niruthiha Selvanayagam and Taher A. Ghaleb / arXiv
why_it_matters: The paper links AI-attributed PRs with AI-attributed review events and shows closed-loop AI review is increasing while still a minority of identified agent activity.
actionable_takeaway: When AI writes and AI reviews a PR, add an independence check and avoid treating same-vendor review as a substitute for human or test-based risk review.
